name: Accounts
summary: A client opens an account and reads it back by ID.

accounts.open.words: opening an account returns its new ID, and the account reads back with a zero balance
accounts.open.plan: open an account through the API; read the stored row for its name and zero balance, then read it back through the API. Proves stored state and the API answer. Reads the account row.

accounts.unknown-404.words: reading an account that does not exist answers 404
accounts.unknown-404.plan: read an ID with no stored row; expect 404 and still no row. Reads the account row.
